LanguageData.MX_NL_UpdateLog_v1_1_103_Body:
Hello everyone. This is the <color=#79CBFF>v1.1.103</color> update, fixing the following issues. If update log letters bother you, you can turn them off in <color=#79CBFF>mod settings</color>. You can also view <color=#79CBFF>all update logs</color> there. Thank you.
1. Fixed an issue where <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli's death/return flow could hand an incomplete Pawn state to the game or other mods</color>. State validation has been added to prevent red errors. 2. Fixed a <color=#E85A7A>red error and crash caused by Neiyu switching weapon forms while hunting</color>. Weapon form switching is now disabled while she is running a hunting Job. 3. Fixed an issue where <color=#E85A7A>Neiyu's bow-form projectiles could break projectile and tracking behavior when other mods changed projectile speed</color>. The tracking logic has been rebuilt. 4. Fixed several small performance costs that did not affect gameplay.
If you encounter any issue, please reply in the <color=#C77DFF>Steam Workshop comments</color>, or open a new discussion thread with the red error log and mod list. Thank you for playing. - Xianmi Team
LanguageData.MX_NL_UpdateLog_v1_1_010_Body:
Hello everyone. This is the <color=#79CBFF>v1.1.010</color> update, focused on fixing known issues:
1. Fixed an issue where <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli's quest could expire immediately after being accepted</color>. If your save encountered this, see the possible recovery steps below. 2. Fixed a possible cause of <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli failing to revive</color>. If your save encountered this, see the possible recovery steps below. 3. Added several <color=#79CBFF>developer actions</color>. If your save encountered issue 1, open the developer actions menu and use <color=#C77DFF>Milira Xian - Zhaoli -> Retry Zhaoli murmur quest check</color>. This will try to trigger Zhaoli's quest again when the save meets the quest requirements. Note that it should not work if your colony already has Zhaoli. If you encountered issue 2, use <color=#C77DFF>Milira Xian - Zhaoli -> Force friendly dead Zhaoli return now</color> to force Zhaoli's return. If that action does not work, the failure is likely caused by a conflict with another mod, and I may not be able to locate it.
LanguageData.MX_NL_UpdateLog_v1_1_001_Body:
Hello everyone. This update introduces the <color=#79CBFF>update log</color> system. If update log letters feel intrusive, open this mod's settings and turn off <color=#79CBFF>Send update log letters</color>. Details follow:
1. Fixed the issue where Zhaoli could be stuck at <color=#E85A7A>1% hunger after collapsing with full Karma</color>, causing colonists to keep feeding her. 2. Added a <color=#79CBFF>Consciousness lock option</color>. Zhaoli and Neiyu can now use 100%, 35%, or no Consciousness lock. <color=#FFB86C>Note:</color> this also affects hostile Zhaoli. Choosing no lock or the 35% lock will lower hostile difficulty accordingly, so choose the mode you prefer. 3. Fixed Zhaoli dropping her weapon when downed, preventing saves from ending up with <color=#FF6A6A>far too many Severance blades</color>. 4. <color=#C77DFF>Zhaoli is now registered with SCM</color>. Local testing did not show issues. 5. Fixed Zhaoli's quest logic consuming too much performance and causing <color=#E85A7A>sharp TPS drops</color>.
If you encounter issues, please report them in the Steam comments. Thank you! <color=#FFB86C>Note:</color> mods that affect projectiles may cause abnormal arrows in Neiyu's bow form.
